verdict.rationale: First-party docs show metrics, logs, and traces collected in one platform: the overview says it unifies logs, metrics, and traces, with metrics ingest via OTel/Prometheus/Elastic Agent, logs in Discover, and APM request tracing. Pivoting between signals with shared context is only implied by a natural-language claim about not switching tabs or context; no trace-to-log or metric-to-trace correlation workflow is documented. Missing for 10: documented cross-signal correlation and pivoting (e.g., trace-to-logs linking, shared service/trace IDs), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: Ingest metrics from any source using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus remote write, or Elastic Agent integrations.
search, filter, and tail all your logs ingested into your project in one place
Elastic APM traces every request across microservices and APIs
resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context
